paragraphs.source_en: No one objected to Mōri Katsunaga's proposal. Yukimura swiftly wrote down the names of the commanders who would defend Chamayama with him: Ōtani Yoshihisa, Watanabe Kurōdo-no-suke, Igi Tōo, Fukushima Masamori, and Fukushima Masashige. When he had finished, Yukimura passed the paper and brush to Katsunaga.

units.source_en: No one objected to Mōri Katsunaga's proposal.
units.source_zh: 对于毛利胜永的提议，大家无异议。

units.source_en: Yukimura swiftly wrote down the names of the commanders who would defend Chamayama with him: Ōtani Yoshihisa, Watanabe Kurōdo-no-suke, Igi Tōo, Fukushima Masamori, and Fukushima Masashige.
units.source_zh: 幸村刷刷写下了和他一起镇守茶磨山众将的名字：大谷吉久、渡边内藏助、伊木远雄、福岛正守、福岛正镇。

units.source_en: When he had finished, Yukimura passed the paper and brush to Katsunaga.
units.source_zh: 写毕，幸村把纸笔递给胜永。

paragraphs.source_zh: 对于毛利胜永的提议，大家无异议。幸村刷刷写下了和他一起镇守茶磨山众将的名字：大谷吉久、渡边内藏助、伊木远雄、福岛正守、福岛正镇。写毕，幸村把纸笔递给胜永。

paragraphs.source_en: Commanders including Nagaoka Okiaki, Makishima Shigetoshi, and Ebara Takatsugu were to defend the ground south of the stone torii between Tennōji and Isshinji; Ōno Harunaga's arquebus corps would lie in ambush forward and to the left of Mōri's army, while Harunaga himself, commanding the main force together with the remnants of the Gotō, Susukida, Inoue, Kimura, and Yamamoto contingents, would take position south of Bishamon in the rear; Ōno Harufusa, Harunaga's younger brother, was naturally the commander-in-chief at Okayamaguchi on the left.

units.source_en: Commanders including Nagaoka Okiaki, Makishima Shigetoshi, and Ebara Takatsugu were to defend the ground south of the stone torii between Tennōji and Isshinji;
units.source_zh: 长冈兴秋、槙岛重利、江原高次等将领镇守天王寺和一心寺之间的石华表以南；

units.source_zh: 大野治长的火枪营则埋伏在毛利军左前方，治长率领主力和后藤、薄田、井上、木村、山本等人的残部，驻扎于后方的毗沙门以南；

units.source_en: Ōno Harufusa, Harunaga's younger brother, was naturally the commander-in-chief at Okayamaguchi on the left.
units.source_zh: 大野治长之弟大野治房自是左方冈山口的总大将。

paragraphs.source_zh: 长冈兴秋、槙岛重利、江原高次等将领镇守天王寺和一心寺之间的石华表以南；大野治长的火枪营则埋伏在毛利军左前方，治长率领主力和后藤、薄田、井上、木村、山本等人的残部，驻扎于后方的毗沙门以南；大野治长之弟大野治房自是左方冈山口的总大将。

paragraphs.source_en: Once they had confirmed their respective positions, the men all let out a sigh.

units.source_en: Once they had confirmed their respective positions, the men all let out a sigh.
units.source_zh: 确认了自己所在，众人都发出了一声叹息。
